title: Influence at the first coordinate
statement: For each real $t$, let $f_t$ be the function on $\{−1,1\}^3$ given, for $x=(x_0,x_1,x_2)$, by $f_t(x)=(t+1)/4+(t/4)x_1+(t/4)x_2-(1/4)x_0x_1+(1/4)x_0x_2+((t-1)/4)x_1x_2$. Its influence at the first coordinate, defined as the uniform average of the squared discrete derivative in that coordinate, is $1/8$.
